name: detain/dep-sec-patcher
description: Multi-language dependency vulnerability scanner and patcher: audits every ecosystem in a project tree, collects GitHub's view of its vulnerabilities into a local database, applies fixes to the manifests and closes issues proven fixed.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Runs audits in parallel (-t N) and forwards Ctrl-C to running tools; without it everything runs one at a time
suggest.ext-posix: Lets a timeout kill a command's whole process tree and reaps daemons tools leave behind

scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the test suite and write a Clover coverage report to build/logs/clover.xml
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan static analysis (level 8, see phpstan.neon.dist)
